title: Apply SHALL/SHOULD/MAY normative keywords consistently
requirements:
- Replace Required/Recommended with the convention of Section 3.5.2
- Choose a single way to record mandatory/optional support for both offered and consumed services
- Define SHALL, SHOULD and MAY with reference to RFC 2119/8174
- Promote machine-readable publication of component specifications and metadata in 5.2 to a SHOULD, with maturity exceptions, consistent with 3.7
- Define conditional, maturity-dependent and use-case applicability
- Add a conditional obligation with machine-readable applicability criteria
- Reconcile them with Required/Recommended/Optional in Appendix C and use one convention consistently
- Replace ambiguous 'would' where a requirement is intended
